title: populus × canadensis var. serotina
intro: Populus × canadensis var. serotina, commonly known as Black Cottonwood or Black Poplar, is a hybrid of the eastern cottonwood (Populus deltoides) and the black cottonwood (Populus trichocarpa). It is a deciduous tree native to North America, valued for its medicinal properties and versatility in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Populus × canadensis var. serotina include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe sore throats, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
